review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment/credit must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). If an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return without applying the operation again, and include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

[team convention] Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 need a second approver (finance policy FIN-2026-03): accept a keyword-only `approved_by` and raise BillingError("approval_required") when it is missing for amounts above the threshold.
